name: Aki no Urara no Gaiden Mayu no Osanazuma Nikki
original_name: 秋のうららの外伝 まゆのおさな妻日記
source:
Kouzue and Mayu have become official lovers, but Kosuzu continues to live together with them. One day Kosuzu leaves home for a training camp. The two lovers can't get enough of each other in her absence. 
Enjoy pseudo honeymoon experience with cute Mayu!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
